title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Reveals Teaser Trailer
content:
The previously announced Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret anime has revealed a teaser trailer. Studio Gekko is animating the series and is set to premiere in April 2027.

The voice cast consists of:

• Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno

• Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya

• Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai

• Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno

Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.

Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows: Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?! Source: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret anime official X (formerly Twitter) , Website © Kashiko Amane / Hakusensha / Blue Impulse/ StarryCube

title: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Game Reveals Year 2 Roadmap; Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond Short Film Reveals Debut Date
content:
Sega revealed on Friday a roadmap for Year Two of its Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game. Year Two will launch on November 3 and the company streamed a video showcasing the new updates.

Year Two will launch with "Duel Mode," a Gadget System upgrade, two new characters Bayonetta and Aigis, and two new machines: McLaren Racing and Butterfly Witch.

The game will release its Godzilla collaboration on November 3 with the launch of Year Two and its Evangelion collaboration in January 2027. The Evangelion collaboration will include two new characters and three new machines.

The Virtual Sanrio Puroland collaboration will launch in Q2 2027 and contain two new characters and two new machines. The Segaland Pack containing the Segaland course, three new machines, and the Midgar Pack (Working Title) from the Final Fantasy VII Remake series will launch in Q3 2027. Sega will release the Reload Revival Royal Pack from the Persona series in Q4 2027.

The season pass content for Year Two will include the Sega Controllers Decal Pack, Consoles Pack, and a pack containing the character Super Shadow and machine Super Dark Flare.

Sega also streamed a trailer for the Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond 35th anniversary short film on Friday. The video reveals the short film will debut on November 12

Sega released the game in September 2025 for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store. The game got a release digitally for Nintendo Switch 2 on December 3. There is a Switch 2 upgrade pack for owners of the Switch version, and progress carries over. The physical Switch 2 release with the full game on the cartridge shipped on March 26.

Sonic Racing CrossWorlds features guests from other Sega franchises including Hatsune Miku, Like a Dragon's Ichiban, and Persona 5 's Joker. The game previously had a crossover with the Nickeledeon animated series SpongeBob SquarePants , and also collaborated with CAPCOM for a Mega Man crossover.

The game also collaborated with both Pac-Man and Minecraft as part of Year One. Classic Sonic launched on June 23, Axel from Crazy Taxi debuted in August, and Amigo from Samba de Amigo joined the game in September.

The game also added music from Sega 's Rhythm Thief & the Emperor's Treasure , Feel the Magic: XY/XX , The Rub Rabbits! , and Space Channel 5 . The game had collaborations with the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and Avatar: The Last Airbender franchises as part of Year One. The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem collaboration debuted in July 2025, and the Avatar Legends collaboration debuted in October 2025.

An animation project for the game debuted in August 2024.
author: ANN

title: Tekken 8 Game Reveals Roger Jr.'s November 11 Early Access Release in Gameplay Trailer
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment started streaming the gameplay reveal trailer for Roger Jr., one of the characters for the Tekken 8 fighting game's Season 3 , on Sunday. The character will be available for early access on November 11, and will launch officially on November 16. The video also previews the in-game model for another Season 3 character Yūjirō Hanma, the father of protagonist Baki Hanma from the Baki manga and anime series. The video announced that a new Yūjirō Hanma trailer will premiere on January 17 at the Tekken World Tour Finals event, which will be held in Singapore.

Other Season 3 characters include Kunimitsu and Bob. Kunimitsu launched on June 2 in Japan and June 1 in the United States. The character launched on Early Access on May 28 in Japan and May 27 in the U.S. Bob released for early access on August 19, and officially released on August 24. Yūjirō Hanma will debut in early 2027.

Season 2 added Anna Williams in March 2025, Fahkumram in July 2025, Armor King on October 13, and Miary Zo on December 4.

Tekken 8 launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in January 2024.

The game featured the following characters at launch: Jin Kazama, Kazuya Mishima, Nina Williams, Jun Kazama, Paul Phoenix, Marshall Law, King, Lars Alexandersson, Jack-8, Ling Xiaoyu, Asuka Kazama, Leroy Smith, Lili, Hwoarang, Bryan, Azucena, Claudio, Raven, Devil Jin, Lee Chaolan, Alisa Bosconovitch, Victor Chevalier, Reina, Leo, Steve, Dragunov, Feng, Yoshimitsu, Shaheen, KUMA, Panda, Zafina, and Lee Chaolan.

The story of the game takes place nearly six months after Tekken 7 . The Guinness World Records recognize the Tekken franchise as having the longest running narrative in video game history.

Eddy Gordo was added to the game in April 2024 as the first DLC character, followed by Lidia Sobieska in July 2024, and Heihachi Mishima in September 2024. The game added Clive Rosfield, the protagonist of Square Enix 's Final Fantasy XVI game, as a playable character in December 2024.

The Tekken: Bloodline anime series, which follows the storyline of the Tekken 3 fighting game, premiered on Netflix in August 2022.

Tekken 8 game director Kohei Ikeda (also known as Nakatsu) announced on June 1 that he has left Bandai Namco Entertainment , having worked at the company for 20 years. Ikeda was the game director on the fighting games Tekken 7 and Tekken 8 , the producer on the Tekken 3D Prime Edition game, and a designer for Tekken Tag Tournament 2 . He was also a designer and battle effect director on SoulCalibur IV .

title: 5th Girls und Panzer das Finale Film Streams 10-Minute Opening Video
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks started streaming on Saturday the first 10 minutes of the fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer das Finale film series.

The fifth film is set after Ōarai Girls High School's win in the fierce semi-finals of the Winter Continuous Track Cup, and they head to the finals, where they will face St. Gloriana Girls' College, led by Darjeeling. Among the members of St. Gloriana Girls' College is Alice, who transferred to St. Gloriana to be able to face Miho again.

The first Girls und Panzer das Finale film opened in Japan in 59 theaters in December 2017. The film features new characters from BC Freedom High School as they engage in a winter battle.

The second film opened in Japan in June 2019. The film depicts the finale of the battle between Ōarai Girls Academy and BC Freedom High School, and also shows the battles for Kuromorimine Girls Academy, Pravda Girls High School, and other schools.

The third film opened in Japanese theaters in March 2021. The film features six more schools competing on three additional battlegrounds.

The fourth film opened in Japan in October 2023. The fourth film continues with Ōarai's battle with Continuation (Jaktkosota) High School, after the loss of important teammates at the onset of the match in the third film. The film also shows the match between two strong schools, Kuromorimine and St. Gloriana, with Kuromorimine headed up by Maho's successor Erika, and St. Gloriana's commander Darjeeling in her last match.

The four Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! films opened in order on December 26, January 30, March 6, and April 10. The manga that spawned these films follows the unknown daily lives of the Ōarai Girls Team and other students. Maruko Nii launched the manga in 2013 in Kadokawa 's (then Media Factory 's) Monthly Comic Alive magazine.

The fourth Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! film included a "pilot video" based on Takeshi Nogami and Takaaki Suzuki 's Girls und Panzer: Ribon no Musha manga .

The Girls und Panzer television anime premiered in October 2012 and had 12 episodes. The Girls und Panzer der Film anime film follow up opened in Japan in November 2015.

title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls Game Reveals Full Roster for Year 1 DLC
content:
The staff for PlayStation Studios , Arc System Works , and Marvel Games' Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls 4v4 tag team fighter game revealed in a new video on Sunday Thor (Jane Foster) as the second DLC character included in the "Year 1 Character & Stage Pass" in winter 2027. The video also introduces the game's first guest musical composer Keiichi Okabe ( Summer Time Rendering , Yuki Yuna Is a Hero ), who composed the theme for Thor (Jane Foster). The game's staff also revealed the full Year 1 roster.

The Year 1 full roster includes Phoenix Cyclops, which will be added to the game on November 2; Thor (Jane Foster); Venom (spring 2027); and Jubilee (summer 2027).

The game launched for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store on August 6 (August 7 in Japan).

The game's Ultimate Edition includes pre-order bonuses, five character costumes, animated chromatic colors unlocked for all 20 launch characters, and the Year One pass that includes four characters and one stage.

Launch characters include: Ms. Marvel, Spider-Man, Peni Parker, Star-Lord, Storm, Wolverine, Magik, Danger, Doctor Doom, Captain America, Iron Man, Hulk, Black Panther, Magneto, Goblin, Carnage, Ghost Rider, Blade, Loki, and Deadpool.

The game has an Episode Mode single-player game mode, which presents a story in a motion comic format. The developers stated "a renowned writer from the original Marvel Comics " helped build the world and write the story of Episode Mode.

Daisuke Suzuki directed the opening movie at animation studio SANZIGEN . Keiko Terada ( SHOW-YA ) and mayu ( NEMOPHILA ) perform the original theme song "Stronger as One." Kanata Okajima wrote the lyrics. MEG (MEGMETAL) composed and arranged the song.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game Streams Trailer for Tekken 8 DLC Character Reina Joining Game in December
content:
SNK began streaming on Saturday a DLC character trailer for Reina from the TEKKEN 8 fighting game that will join its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game in December. SNK also released on Thursday DLC character trailers for Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from the Tokyo Revengers anime.

Aleks Le voices Manjiro Sano in English and Yuu Hayashi voices the character in Japanese.

Sean Chiplock voices Ken Ryuguji in English and Masaya Fukunishi voices the character in Japanese.

Manjiro Sano and Ken Ryuguji from the Tokyo Revengers anime will join the game as Season 3 DLC characters on October 22.

Season 3 launched on July 23 with six characters joining the roster. Rick Strowd joined the game on July 23. Duck King launched on August 27. Kim Kaphwan joined the game's roster on September 24. The game will add Laocorn in November, as well as Reina in December.

The game's crossover with Street Fighter includes characters Ken and Chun-Li. Both characters are a part of the game's Season Pass 1. The game launched Andy Bogard as a playable character in June 2025, added Ken as a playable character in August 2025, introduced Joe Higashi as a playable character in October 2025, debuted Chun-Li in November 2025, and launched MR. BIG in December 2025.

Kim Jae Hoon, the first DLC character for the game's Season Pass 2, launched on January 22. Nightmare Geese launched on February 26, and Blue Mary debuted on March 26. Wolfgang Krauser debuted in the game on April 24, coinciding with the game's first anniversary. DLC character Mr. Karate launched on May 27. Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star debuted in the game on June 28.

The game added real-life DJ Salvatore Ganacci, professional soccer player Cristiano Ronaldo, and Hokutomaru. Other returning characters include Terry Bogard, Rock Howard, Tizoc, Hotaru Futaba, Marco Rodrigues, B. Jenet, Kevin Rian, Billy Kane, Mai Shiranui, Kim Dong Hwan, and Gato. The game also includes the new characters Preecha and Vox Reaper.
author: ANN

title: Inori's Homunculus Tears Yuri Novel Gets Manga by Ayster, Dokico
content:
German publisher Dokico announced on Saturday that Ayster will draw a manga adaptation of author Inori 's Homunculus Tears: Alchemy for the Brokenhearted ( Homunculus no Namida ~Kietai Kimi e no Renkinjutsu~ ) novel. Dokico will begin releasing the manga in German, English, and Japanese simultaneously in January 2027.

Inori offered the following statement regarding the manga adaptation:

“Homunculus Tears: Alchemy for the Brokenhearted” is getting a manga adaptation! Though the previous plans for it had to be canceled, the project has been restructured and is officially moving forward. [...]

I wrote this novel for my teenage self, who didn't believe she had a place in life, and for all those who have ever felt the same. It's a dear story to me, and although there have been many twists and turns, I have found an artist who understands its painful yet caring nature. I hope Ayster-sensei's Maha and Ruri will keep you company on a cold, lonely night, and I hope you're as excited about this adaptation as I am.

Ayster offered the following statement regarding the manga adaptation:

I'm honored to be drawing the manga adaptation of Homunculus Tears! I'll do my best to bring Maha and Ruri's story to life! Thank you for your support!

The announcement notes that there was an earlier announcement for a manga adaptation of the novel, which originally had Nata Ōkura and Kadokawa working on it, but the project fell through.

Inori self-published the original novel digitally in Japanese in April 2025, as well as in English in May 2025. Sekai Edition published the novel in Spanish, and Dokico handled the German release. Kevin Ishizaka worked on the novel's English translation. AONOSHIMO drew the illustration for the novel.

Inori describes the novel:

Amid a prolonged conflict between humans and demons, humanity stands on the brink. The protagonist, Maha, is a powerful human alchemist fighting on the frontlines. One day, however, Maha's mother, Diriyah—who is also an engineer—announces that she has achieved a breakthrough by successfully creating a “Homunculus” through the use of alchemy. According to Diriyah, with the Homunculus to stand in and fight, humanity can triumph over the demons without further sacrifice of human lives. Paying little heed to the rejoicing troops, Maha—who has only ever found purpose on the battlefield—is shaken by the prospect of losing the only meaning in life she has ever known. “If I'm not even expected to fight… What exactly am I supposed to do?” This is a story about overcoming the despair of having never wanted to be born.

Dokico announced on June 25 earlier this year that it will release its first original light novel series titled Poison for the Moon, Medicine for the Night—An Assassin Who Longs for Death and a Vampire Marked for Death ( Tsuki ni Doku, Yoru ni Kusuri: Shinitai Ansatsusha to, Shi wo Nozomareru Kyūketsuki ), under the company's Yurico project, with the first volume scheduled for release digitally worldwide in December. Inori is writing the story with illustration by Komizuki .

AONOSHIMO launched a manga adaptation of the novel series in Ichijinsha 's Comic Yuri Hime magazine in June 2020, where it is currently ongoing. Ichijinsha published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on April 17. Seven Seas Entertainment is also publishing the manga in English.

The series inspired a television anime adaptation that premiered in October 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the anime.

Inori launched the series' sequel titled I'm in Love with the Villainess: Come on and Notice Me Already ( Furimukinasai, Watakushi ni! ) with its first volume on January 26. Hanagata returned as the illustrator for the novel. The novel focuses on Rae and Claire's daughter Aleah. Seven Seas will release the novel in English in January 2027.

Inori launched a spinoff story titled Heimin no Kuse ni Namaikina! on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in May 2021, and ended it in October 2021. GL Bunko released the story in a digital novel volume in February 2022. Seven Seas Entertainment also released the novel spinoff with the title I'm in Love with the Villainess Spin-Off: She's so Cheeky for a Commoner .

According to Diriyah, with the Homunculus to stand in and fight, humanity can triumph over the demons without further sacrifice of human lives. Paying little heed to the rejoicing troops, Maha—who has only ever found purpose on the battlefield—is shaken by the prospect of losing the only meaning in life she has ever known. “If I'm not even expected to fight… What exactly am I supposed to do?” This is a story about overcoming the despair of having never wanted to be born.

Dokico announced on June 25 earlier this year that it will release its first original light novel series titled Poison for the Moon, Medicine for the Night—An Assassin Who Longs for Death and a Vampire Marked for Death ( Tsuki ni Doku, Yoru ni Kusuri: Shinitai Ansatsusha to, Shi wo Nozomareru Kyūketsuki ), under the company's Yurico project, with the first volume scheduled for release digitally worldwide in December. Inori is writing the story with illustration by Komizuki .

contentBlocks.credit: Image courtesy of Seven Seas Entertainment

contentBlocks.text: AONOSHIMO launched a manga adaptation of the novel series in Ichijinsha 's Comic Yuri Hime magazine in June 2020, where it is currently ongoing. Ichijinsha published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on April 17. Seven Seas Entertainment is also publishing the manga in English.
The series inspired a television anime adaptation that premiered in October 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the anime.

Inori launched the series' sequel titled I'm in Love with the Villainess: Come on and Notice Me Already ( Furimukinasai, Watakushi ni! ) with its first volume on January 26. Hanagata returned as the illustrator for the novel. The novel focuses on Rae and Claire's daughter Aleah. Seven Seas will release the novel in English in January 2027.

Inori launched a spinoff story titled Heimin no Kuse ni Namaikina! on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in May 2021, and ended it in October 2021. GL Bunko released the story in a digital novel volume in February 2022. Seven Seas Entertainment also released the novel spinoff with the title I'm in Love with the Villainess Spin-Off: She's so Cheeky for a Commoner .

title: Live-Action Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata Season 2 Reveals More Cast, October 29 Debut
content:
The official website for the second season of the live-action series of Ogeretsu Tanaka 's Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata (The Right Way to Write Love) boys-love manga revealed more cast members, the October 29 debut on Tokyo MX1, and a new visual for the second season on October 7.

The new cast members include:

• Rina Komiyama (upper left in image above) as Maki Oda

• Takumi Bandō (top center) as Kyōsuke Hiiragi

• Tamami Sakaguchi (upper right) as Matsuri Inui

The returning cast members from the first season include:

• Nanami Asahi (lower left) as Aoi Shiina

• Saya Emori (bottom center) as Reina Kaga

• Tetsunori Akira (lower right) as Hajime Kondō

Genki Iwahashi and Satoru Sōma reprise their roles as Hiromu Suzuki and Natsuo Washizawa, respectively.

Yasuki Satō returns to direct the second season, with Motoko Takahashi also returning to write scripts.

The first season debuted on Tokyo MX1 in July 2025.

The manga centers on Hiromu, who was once bullied by Natsuo in high school for his appearance and demeanor. After high school, Hiromu completely remade himself, going to beauty school and striving to make himself handsome. Now an adult working in a beauty parlor, Hiromu has a coincidental reunion with Natsuo, but Natsuo doesn't recognize him. After they grow closer and Natsuo admits he has feelings for him, Hiromu vows to break up with him in a grand way as revenge for being bullied.

Tanaka published the manga in 2015.

SuBLime previously released Tanaka's Yarichin Bitch-bu and Escape Journey manga in English. Yarichin Bitch-bu inspired an OVA adaptation in 2018. Tanaka's Happy of the End boys-love manga also inspired a live-action series in September 2024. Manga publisher KUMA licensed Tanaka's Mermaid Prince manga.

title: 'Kino no Tabi' Creator Duo Begins New Light Novel
content:
Publishing company Kadokawa announced on Friday that author Keiichi Sigsawa and illustrator Kouhaku Kuroboshi , the duo behind the Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World ( Kino's Journey: The Beautiful World ) light novel, will launch a new light novel titled Drifted: John Smith no Edo Hyouryuu Kitan . Mobile online game developer coly is credited for the original concept. The first volume will be published under the Dengeki Bunko imprint on November 10.

Sigsawa began penning Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World in the Dengeki hp magazine with illustrations by Kuroboshi in March 2000. Kadokawa published the first volume under the Dengeki Bunko label in July that year. The 24th volume went on sale in September 2025.

Tokyopop originally licensed the light novel in English and released the first volume in October 2006. However, due to issues with the licensor, the publisher was unable to release further volumes and its license for the series subsequently expired.

The first television anime adaptation directed by Ryuutarou Nakamura ( Serial Experiments Lain ) at A.C.G.T. aired in Spring 2003. A prequel and sequel movie were released in February 2005 and April 2007, with the latter being produced by Shaft .

ADV Films originally licensed the first television anime in North America and released it in four DVDs throughout 2004 with English subtitles and dub. Sentai Filmworks relicensed the anime and streamed it on HIDIVE with an English dub and sub.

A second television anime adaptation , directed by Tomohisa Taguchi ( Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen ) at Lerche , aired in Fall 2017. Crunchyroll simulcasted the series with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.

Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World ranked in the Best Light Novel category of the Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! guidebook three times, placing 2nd in 2006, 5th in 2007, and 6th in 2008.

Synopsis John Smith, a former American soldier who washed ashore in late Edo-period Japan, is granted samurai status and the name Sumisu Jion by Shogun Tokugawa Ienari. His main duty is to investigate and recover modern firearms that have mysteriously appeared due to temporal distorsions, in a world also inhabited by superhuman ninja, sorcerers, and spirits. Smith undertakes these dangerous missions in the hope of one day returning to his homeland to reunite with his wife and children.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Film's New Video Reveals Bi Clan's Cast
content:
TOHO animation began streaming a character trailer for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, on Monday. The trailer highlights the Bi clan, and announces the cast members for the clan's important characters.

The cast members include ( Note: Character name Romanizations are not official ) Nobuo Tobita as Bi clan head Birō, Kumiko Watanabe as Birō's wife Shūu, and Hirofumi Nojima as the Bi clan's eldest son Bisen. The trailer also shows the previously revealed cast member Mariya Ise as key character and Bi clan son Mu Qing.

TOHO animation will present more character videos over the next two days: for the Kaja Troupe on October 13, and for Ruo Qing and Yi Shan on October 14 (all name Romanizations not confirmed).

The story follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11 and feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . Mariya Ise joins the cast as Mu Qing (English romanization not confirmed).

Crunchyroll announced on Thursday it has acquired the North American and worldwide rights (excluding Asia but including India) to the film. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will announce the release date at a later time.

The third television anime season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours . Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub .

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll is streaming the second season, and it is also streaming an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print. Viz Media is releasing Minoji Kurata 's separate manga adaptation titled The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao’s Notes on the Inner Palace .
